extraction.notes: Three-month 2025 column used. 'Gain on sales of real estate' shows an em dash for Q2 2025 (zero); recorded as 0. 'Loss on extinguishment of debt and modification costs' is an em dash for Q2 2025 (zero); recorded as 0. Diluted shares 25,384 equals basic because the company is in a net loss position; it reproduces FFO $0.67, Core FFO $0.71, AFFO $0.80. AFFO does not deduct recurring capex, so recurring capex of 3,247 (quarter) was taken from the Historical Capital Expenditures table on page 20; scope is not labeled explicitly as company share, so it is recorded as company total.
